action: No change needed. Production is on track.

action: Move operations to drier faces or working hours and start dewatering first.

action: Position pumps, clear drainage and identify drier faces to switch to if the alert rises.

action: Move heavy haulage to the driest part of the day and reduce dumper trips on the wet sections.

title: Prepare haul roads
action: Inspect and grade the wet haul-road sections and plan which trips can be moved to drier hours.

action: Switch to the alternate haul route and reduce dumper loads on the low-friction segment.

title: Identify an alternate haul route
action: Identify the alternate haul route and brief dumper operators, so the switch is quick if the alert rises.

action: No change to the plan. Inspect drainage and keep pumps positioned.

action: Move the next blast to a dry window and confirm drainage before charging holes.
